engines.name: LTX Generative Repair
engines.author: idocinthebox
engines.description: Frame repair lab with five backends. ATR Film Reconstruction (built into ATR 6.2.2+): recovers the masked pixels from neighbouring frames where the camera actually photographed them, with per-pixel provenance - recovered, MISPLACED (real pixels the engine could not place, flagged for you to check), unrecovered (left as source), or synthesized only if you opt in. OpenCV (built in). Cloud and Self-Hosted (your own LTX API key / endpoint). ProPainter (optional free install you perform yourself; NTU S-Lab License 1.0 - non-commercial use only). Includes batch repair with provenance sidecar and streaming export.

engines.name: ATR Story Renderer
engines.author: idocinthebox
engines.description: Generate before/after demos and restoration report videos from ATR job artifacts. Includes FFmpeg + optional HyperFrames backend, alpha exports (ProRes 4444 / PNG sequence), HTML preview, and Resolve overlay pack helper.
